prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling game parallax background for Kiki / Melos Game stage 1-9, a mechanical trickster theatre designed for a surprising promotional trailer. Create one polished wide landscape 2048x1152 painted background, opaque. Original hand-painted cartoon game art: bold clear shapes, warm wooden theatre/carnival architecture, turquoise and coral roofs, brass gears, a distant oversized wheel, glowing amber bulbs, playful striped awnings, a soft peach-to-cyan sky. Stage atmosphere is bright and mischievous, not a dark cave. All architectural objects are distant, with low contrast. Keep the broad middle half of the picture quiet and open so many small foreground enemies and a red-caped hero will read clearly. Large-scale sweeping perspective and layered depth, but flat orthographic side-view compatible. No foreground ground, platforms, monsters, people, traps, interface, lettering, logos or watermark. No black frame or white border. This must be an actual usable game background, not a screenshot or concept sheet. Full bleed artwork with consistent soft painted highlights and firm silhouettes.
prompts.enemy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production enemy sprite sheet for a 2D side-scrolling cartoon game, stage 1-9 mechanical trickster theatre. Primary request: an original small mischievous clockwork gremlin that can appear as a dense crowd. Rounded teal body, oversized coral-red theatre mask/head, one pair of bright golden eyes, a wide toothy grin, two short dark boots, tiny brass wind-up key behind its back, small cream ruff. Bold silhouette, playful menace, no gore. Style: polished hand-painted 2D platform game sprite with clean dark outline and simple shading, legible when only 50 pixels tall, not realistic or 3D. Composition: exactly FOUR equal animation frames in one single horizontal strip, facing RIGHT in orthographic side view; running sequence with alternating legs and slight squash. Same character, same proportions, same scale and baseline in all four frames. Each character fully visible and centered in its own square cell with generous 12% transparent padding; no frame overlaps. Transparent background with true alpha, no ground, no shadows outside the character, no labels, lettering, grid, border or checkerboard. Desired sheet aspect ratio 4:1, at least 2048x512 if possible. This is a usable animation atlas, not a character concept board.
prompts.gate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one animated giant trap-gate atlas for an original 2D platform game, a magical mechanical carnival theatre. Create EXACTLY THREE equal square cells in one horizontal 3:1 strip, transparent true-alpha background, with the SAME full gate at the SAME scale and bottom baseline in every cell. Cell 1: an inviting coral-red and teal wooden theatre arch with amber bulbs, a golden little flag on top, a closed innocent grinning face built into its upper arch, a dark empty passage below. Cell 2: the SAME gate suddenly becomes a huge hungry mechanical mouth: amber eyes snap open, top jaw rises, oversized ivory/brass triangular teeth and dark violet mouth cavity, lower jaw wide open; the passage is the mouth. Cell 3: the SAME mouth after slamming shut, cheeks squash, teeth interlock, comic angry expression, a few brass bolts/concentrated motion accents attached to the silhouette. The arch is the monster, not a character standing in a door. All gates fully visible, no cropped pennants, generous transparent margins around each cell, no overlap. Orthographic frontal flat side-scroller prop view. Bold silhouettes, polished hand-painted cartoon game art, firm dark outlines, warm wooden planks, coral enamel and teal trim, simple large forms legible at 300 pixels high. Playful menacing surprise, no gore, no humans or small enemies, no ground, no interface, letters, numbers, captions, cell borders or checkerboard. Desired output 2048x682 horizontal.
prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent wide ground/platform sprite for an original 2D side-scrolling mechanical carnival theatre game. Create ONE long horizontal suspended theatre stage platform, roughly 3:1 wide aspect ratio. The top surface is a perfectly straight thin golden rim, clearly visible and flat for a character to stand on. Below: warm wooden planks, coral-red enamel structural face, teal metal bracing, brass bolts and a row of four small amber lights; scalloped theatre ornament on the lower edge. Flat orthographic side view, no diagonal perspective, no roof, no steps, no supports reaching off canvas. Polished hand-painted cartoon game art matching a whimsical coral/teal/brass carnival. Clean strong silhouette and readable at 80 pixels high, moderate detail rather than noise. Centered, whole platform fully inside canvas with generous transparent margins, true alpha transparent background. No floor shadow, backdrop, text, labels, checkerboard, grid, borders, logos, people, creatures or other objects. Desired output 1536x512.
prompts.hammer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production rotating trap sprite for an original 2D side-scrolling mechanical trickster theatre game. A gigantic playful clockwork carnival hammer: circular brass pivot at the very TOP, one long straight brass shaft extending vertically downward, an oversized heavy rectangular CORAL RED hammer head at the BOTTOM with teal metal side bands, warm wooden center, brass bolts and small amber lights. Full entire mechanism inside canvas with generous transparent margins, clean orthographic side view, vertical resting pose. Top pivot and shaft perfectly centered on the same vertical axis so a game can rotate the whole sprite around the top pivot. Head is massive and readable, three times wider than shaft. Polished hand-painted cartoon game art, bold clean dark outline, simple painted highlights, mischievous toy-like mechanical object, not realistic or 3D. True alpha transparent background. No characters, hands, scene, floor, shadows outside silhouette, loose particles, text, labels, logos, watermark, borders or checkerboard. Desired output portrait 1024x1536. This must be a usable game prop.
